summary: The victim received automated phone calls impersonating Binance that falsely claimed an account withdrawal attempt was in progress and provided a verification code to create urgency. The recipient did not have a Binance account indicating the calls were part of a phishing campaign targeting personal information or credentials.
user_mistake: Considered the authenticity of an unsolicited security call claiming to be from Binance.
prevention: Ignore unsolicited security calls claiming to be from exchanges / Contact the exchange only through its official website
